column1: # CHAOS-8166: per-test `go test -race` wall milliseconds of internal/providersync, the weight ci/go_providersync_race_shard.awk
# balances the race shards by (the package ran as ONE test binary in one race leg: 565 s in CI, 94% of the 600 s timeout).
# CHAOS-10480: re-measured on bigboy at origin/main a0e1d809 plus the github files test fixture cuts: each test is the MEDIAN of
# 3 runs of the 3 race shards with the CI flags (GOMAXPROCS=4 go test -race -trimpath -mod=readonly -count=1 -json, the shard
# regex of this awk). Only tests of 1 s or more are listed; every other test weighs the awk default (20 ms: the 1,8xx tests
# under 1 s add up to about 35 s). A new test of 1 s or more needs its row here, or the shard plan cannot see its cost.
# Test name, TAB, milliseconds. Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates; `go test -list` names every row (see check_providersync_race_shard).
